structural_change: q15 r13 BAND relay successor (claude/q15-band-successor). Measured predecessor failure: one std-cell root over 10,798 pin flops on three faces (TT 997..1756 ps) AND single-cycle port<->lane paths of 1.4-1.8 mm (c17 pins interleave each lane's 256 tw/ty bits over the whole face). Fix: lanes MX (tw/ty face toward N), two relay stations per lane per bus group (TW, TY, TT, CP, S) at planned points (worst planned hop 666 um), station flops on 42 local std-cell roots, face pin flops on 12 segment roots, Codex tree3 valid/fault (3 edges). Edges: lane inputs +2, round trip +2 LNK units (pw/f +4, returned tt +4), ty +8. Exact equivalence vs predecessor: rtl/test/qwen_band_relay (3 mutants fail).

reroute_reason.why: structural: relay stations + local roots replace the 10.8k-flop single root and 1.8 mm single-cycle paths
